verdict.rationale: Clara documents card-level spend controls, including merchant-category, time and day-of-week restrictions and periodic limits. Its homepage also claims 'automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance.' Nothing shows a codified policy engine that auto-approves in-policy expenses and routes only exceptions to a human. Missing for 10: role-based policy rules, an auto-approval mechanism for in-policy expenses, exception routing to human approvers, documented approval-workflow configuration, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can codify our expense policy — limits by category, role, and context — so in-policy expenses auto-approve and only exceptions reach a human

citations.quote: Automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance for full visibility and reduced manual work
Use the Card Configurations API to add time, day-of-week, or merchant category restrictions. All fields are optional and can be combined.
`periodicity`: `"MONTHLY"`, `"WEEKLY"`, or `"DAILY"` — determines when the limit resets
